newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London drift sideways in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London drift sideways in quiet market.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London drifted sideways on Tuesday awaiting the results of the U.S. FOMC meeting later today.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 3.50 points, or 0.03 percent at 12,836.03 by 1625 GMT.
Traders said the only slight movement in the market had been from the Hong Kong banks.
"The rest of the market has been extremely dull with low volume and people are just sitting on their hands ahead of the results of the Fed meeting," one trader said.
